description: Vanilla web components and the web apps built from them. No frameworks, no third-party component libraries, no build step.

groups.blurb: Complete pages served here, composed from the components below.
groups.title: Apps

groups.blurb: Reusable custom elements. Each ships with a demo and a README.
groups.title: Components

groups.blurb: Base classes every component builds on.
groups.title: Shared

groups.blurb: Feed exporters and other helpers. Source only, not served as pages.
groups.title: Tools

items.description: RSS-style feed of matched auction lots backed by feed.json. New auctions arrive like new feed entries; expired auctions page into the archive.
items.title: eBidLocal Watchlist
Deal Watch
items.description: Sortable, filterable results tables for the deal-watch scans (kids scooter, adult scooter, 24V ride-on). Backed by per-hunt feed JSON regenerated after each scan.

items.title: <deal-watch-table>
items.description: Sortable/filterable results table. Fetches a deal-watch feed JSON from src (or receives dealwatch:data) and renders price vs baseline, stock, badges, and spec columns.
App shell. Fetches a feed JSON from src and emits watchlist:data / watchlist:error.
items.title: <ebidlocal-watchlist>

items.description: Groups lots by category (default) or auction via group-by; forwards watchlist:filter into its shadow tree.
items.title: <watchlist-feed>

items.description: Expandable auction/feed entry. Consumes watchlist:filter, contains lot cards.
items.title: <auction-entry>
<category-entry>
items.description: One named keyword list. Collapsed by default; click to expand its lot cards.
Presentational leaf for one lot. Pure attributes in, no events out.
items.title: <lot-card>

items.description: Debounced search input. Emits watchlist:filter.
items.title: <filter-bar>

items.description: Event-source scoping (event-source attribute → shadow host → parent → document.body), tracked on()/off() listeners, namespaced emit().
items.title: WebComponent

items.description: Change-aware exporter: scan state → feed.json; expired auctions → archive/. Regenerates only when the auction set changes.
items.title: export-feed.py
Spending Dashboard
items.description: Personal spending analyzer: timeline, category donut, merchants, insights, budgets, transaction table, CSV import. Demo runs on synthetic data.

items.title: <spending-dashboard>
items.description: Root shell. Owns data + filter state; fans out spend:data to children.

items.title: <spend-filter-bar>
items.description: Month range, search, category picker, card-payments toggle. Emits spend:filter.

items.title: <spend-overview>
items.description: Stat cards: total, count, top category, largest purchase, vs-prior-period delta.

items.title: <spend-timeline>
items.description: Canvas monthly-bars / cumulative-line chart. Click a bar to drill into that month.

items.title: <spend-category-chart>
items.description: Canvas donut + legend of spend by category. Click to filter.

items.title: <spend-merchant-list>
items.description: Top merchants with proportional bars. Click to search that merchant.

items.title: <spend-insights>
items.description: Auto-generated observations: biggest month, concentration, recurring charges, trends.

items.title: <spend-budget-tracker>
items.description: Editable per-category monthly targets with actual-vs-target bars (localStorage).

items.title: <spend-transaction-table>
items.description: Sortable, paginated table of the filtered transactions.

items.title: <spend-csv-import>
items.description: Drag-and-drop statement CSVs; client-side parse, dedupe, categorize via rules.js.

items.title: spend-utils
items.description: Formatting, palettes, canvas helpers shared by the spending components.

items.title: <spend-sankey>
items.description: Canvas Sankey diagram: total spend → categories → merchants. Click a band to filter.
